stepDemo.title: Compliance Checks
stepDemo.agent: Translator + Compliance Checker + Master Data Agent

stepDemoFull.title: End-to-End Agentic Process Overview
bullets: Trigger: Vendor sends an email with the Service Invoice (PDF / scanned image / XML) to the dedicated Agentic AI mailbox

stepDemoFull.title: Email Receipt & Initial Ingestion
bullets: The Orchestrator Agent continuously monitors the dedicated inbox using Microsoft Graph API / Outlook Connector / IMAP.
New email with attachment(s) is detected.
Email metadata (From, Subject, Date, Vendor Email) and attachments are captured.
A unique Global Service Invoice ID is generated (e.g., SERV-INV-20260511-784512).
The email + attachment is archived and forwarded to Service PO Extractor Agent.

stepDemoFull.title: Extraction (Service PO Extractor Agent)
bullets: Agent Activation: Extractor Agent receives the raw email and attachment.
Document Processing:
Determines file type (PDF, Image, XML, etc.).
Applies OCR + AI Document Intelligence (NA10 / Azure Form Recognizer / similar).
Handles multi-page invoices and complex tables.
Key Data Extracted:
Vendor Name / Vendor Code
Invoice Number & Invoice Date
PO Number (critical for Service PO)
Service Entry Sheet (SES) Number (if mentioned)
Line items: Service Description, Service Number, Quantity, Unit, Rate, Amount
Tax details, Total Amount, Currency
Payment Due Date, Bank Details
Any supporting documents (SES approval, delivery note)
Service-Specific Extraction:
Identifies Item Category ‘D’ references (SAP) or Resource lines (BC).
Extracts account assignment hints (Cost Center, WBS, Project No.).
Quality Check:
Confidence scoring per field and overall document.
(Demo shows all fields above 85% – no exception routing)
Output: Structured JSON payload containing all extracted data + original document link.
Hand-off: Payload sent to Service PO Translator Agent.

stepDemoFull.title: Compliance Checks (Service Compliance Checker Agent + Service Master Data Agent)
bullets: Translator Agent first normalizes the data:
Language translation
Currency & UoM conversion
Tax code standardization (e.g., “VAT 12%” → System Tax Code “UZ_VAT12”)
Field formatting per ERP rules
Compliance Checker Agent performs layered validations:
Vendor Validation (via Service Master Data Agent):
Vendor exists and is active in the relevant Company Code.
Vendor not blocked for posting/payment.
Bank account matches (fraud prevention).
Tax ID / GSTIN / PINFL matches master record.
Regulatory & Policy Compliance:
Country-specific rules (Uzbekistan VAT, India GST, etc.).
Withholding tax applicability for services.
Document Completeness:
PO Number is present and valid.
Service lines are properly identified.
Duplicate Check:
Searches across SAP + BC using Vendor + Invoice No. + Date + Amount.
Decision:
All checks passed → Proceed to Validation Agent.
(Demo shows every check as passed—green tick on each.)

stepDemoFull.title: Validation (Service Validation Agent)
bullets: This is the Three-Way Match stage specifically for Service POs.
Validation Agent receives normalized payload.
ERP Routing: Orchestrator identifies target system (SAP or D365 BC) based on Company Code / PO prefix.
Matching Process:
For SAP:
Retrieves PO details (ME23N logic) using PO Number.
Verifies Item Category = D (Services).
Checks Service Entry Sheet (SES) status in ML81N — must be Accepted.
Compares: Quantities / Amounts between Invoice vs Accepted SES vs PO; Account assignments.
For D365 Business Central:
Retrieves Purchase Order.
Checks if Posted Purchase Receipt exists for the Resource / Service lines.
Compares: Qty. to Invoice vs Qty. Received; Unit Cost and Line Amounts.
Tolerance Check:
Applies configured tolerances (Price, Quantity, Amount).
SAP: Uses OMR6 / LIV tolerances.
BC: Uses Purchases & Payables Setup tolerances.
Decision:
Match within tolerance → Auto-approve and send to Posting Agent.
(Demo shows all quantities and amounts matching, tolerance bar within the green “auto-approve” zone.)

stepDemoFull.title: Posting (Service Posting Agent)
bullets: Only clean, validated invoices reach this stage.
Posting Agent receives approved payload.
Final Enrichment:
Pulls latest account assignments (Cost Center, WBS, Project, etc.).
Applies correct tax codes and G/L accounts.
System-Specific Posting:
For SAP:
Uses BAPI_INCOMINGINVOICE_CREATE or IDoc (INVOIC01) or calls MIRO-equivalent API.
References PO Number + Accepted SES.
Posts the invoice in MIRO background mode.
Updates PO history with Invoice Receipt (IR).
For D365 Business Central:
Creates Purchase Invoice document via API / Web Service.
Uses Get Receipt Lines (if receipt-based) or direct PO invoicing.
Posts the Purchase Invoice.
Updates PO status and creates Vendor Ledger Entry.
Post-Posting Actions:
Creates Vendor Open Item.
Sends confirmation email to AP team and Vendor (optional).
Updates central audit log and dashboard.
Triggers Payment Proposal Run (F110 in SAP / Payment Journal in BC) if due date is met.
Success Confirmation:
Posting Agent returns Posted Document Number (SAP Invoice Doc No. / BC Posted Invoice No.).
Orchestrator marks the Global Service Invoice ID as “Completed”.

flowExplanationCards.title: Intelligent Invoice Intake
flowExplanationCards.body:
Vendor emails the service invoice (PDF / scanned image / XML) to a dedicated mailbox.
Orchestrator Agent monitors via Microsoft Graph API / Outlook Connector / IMAP and captures From, Subject, Date, and attachments.
Generates Global Service Invoice ID (SERV-INV-20260511-784512), archives securely, and hands off to the Service PO Extractor Agent.

flowExplanationCards.title: Central Orchestration & Routing
flowExplanationCards.body:
Orchestrator Agent assigns the Global Service Invoice ID and logs events to the central audit trail.
Routes the invoice package asynchronously across agents and maintains state (Received → Extraction → Validating → Posting → Completed).
Selects the target ERP (SAP S/4HANA or Dynamics 365 BC) based on Company Code / PO prefix.

flowExplanationCards.title: Intelligent Document Extraction
flowExplanationCards.body:
Service PO Extractor Agent ingests email + attachments and detects PDF / image / XML.
Runs OCR + AI Document Intelligence to extract header (Vendor, Invoice No., PO, SES, Currency, Total) and line items (Service, Qty, UoM, Rate, Amount, Cost Center hints) plus tax/banking details.
Applies confidence scoring per field (ideal flow >85%) and outputs a structured JSON payload for the Service PO Translator Agent.

flowExplanationCards.title: ERP-Ready Data Normalisation
flowExplanationCards.body:
Service PO Translator Agent standardises the payload for posting.
Translates language when needed, converts currency/UoM, and normalises formats (dates, vendor codes, PO numbers).
Maps tax text to system codes (e.g., “VAT 12%” → UZ_VAT12) and forwards to compliance.

flowExplanationCards.title: Compliance & Master Data Assurance
flowExplanationCards.body:
Compliance Checker Agent + Master Data Agent validate vendor and policy controls before posting.
Confirms vendor active/not blocked, bank & Tax ID match, PO valid, and service lines identified correctly.
Runs country tax/withholding checks and duplicate detection across SAP and Dynamics 365 BC.
All checks pass → proceed to three-way match.

flowExplanationCards.title: Three-Way Match & Tolerance Control
flowExplanationCards.body:
Service Validation Agent executes the service three-way match with ERP-specific logic.
SAP: verify Item Category D, confirm ML81N SES = Accepted, match Invoice vs SES vs PO.
Dynamics 365 BC: confirm Posted Purchase Receipt, match Invoice Qty/Cost vs Received Qty/Cost.
Apply tolerances (SAP OMR6 / BC Purchases Setup) and auto-approve within threshold.

flowExplanationCards.title: Automated ERP Posting
flowExplanationCards.body:
Service Posting Agent enriches with latest account assignments (Cost Center, WBS), tax codes, and G/L determination.
SAP: post via BAPI_INCOMINGINVOICE_CREATE (MIRO background), reference PO + SES, generate SAP Invoice Document No.
Dynamics 365 BC: create/post Purchase Invoice via API, use Get Receipt Lines, create Vendor Ledger Entry.
Trigger F110 / Payment Journal (when due) and send confirmation notifications.

flowExplanationCards.title: Audit-Ready Completion
flowExplanationCards.body:
Orchestrator marks the Global Service Invoice ID as Completed and links it to the posted document number.
Dashboard updates instantly and every action is recorded in the Agentic AI Operations Audit Log.
Outcome: fully automated, traceable, and compliant service invoice posting.
